basic_details.job_title: NAM Thrissur Multi Purpose Health Worker Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on the date specified in the notification.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | multi purpose health worker: Kerala Nursing and Midwives Council registration for Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) or recognized GNM nursing.

salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview. If more than 20 candidates apply
a written exam will be conducted along with the interview.
how_to_apply: Go through the detailed notification carefully and decide eligibility before applying.
Fill up all relevant fields of the application form completely.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates proving age and educational qualifications along with the original certificates for verification.
Place the application in a sealed envelope superscribed as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MULTI PURPOSE HEALTH WORKER" (NAME OF THE POST).

Submit the application directly or through post on or before 19/10/2026 to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National AYUSH Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur.
Attend the walk-in interview on 22/10/2026 at 10:30 AM at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager Office, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital, Thrissur.
important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only on working days from 10 AM to 5 PM. Applications received after 5 PM on 19/10/2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications through E-mail will not be accepted. Applications submitted in any format other than the format given along with the notification will be rejected. Incomplete or incorrect applications will be summarily rejected. Candidates must maintain an active personal e-mail ID and mobile number until the completion of the recruitment process. False, tampered, or fabricated information will lead to rejection of candidature. Equivalency certificates must be produced along with the application if possessing equivalent qualifications.
